title: Common Size Statement of Balance Sheet
body: Common Size Statement of Balance Sheet: It's structure is as follows. All the details of balance sheet are disclosed as it is. The amount of two years are disclosed. The comparison is possible only if the details of two or more than two years are available. The total of balance sheet is considered as the base, and liabilities and assets of respective year are disclosed in their proportion to total of balance sheet. Here, the proportions are determined in vertical form.
body_hi: सामान्य आकार का तुलन पत्र (बैलेंस शीट): इसकी संरचना इस प्रकार है। बैलेंस शीट का सारा विवरण ज्यों का त्यों प्रकट किया जाता है। दो वर्षों की राशि का खुलासा किया जाता है। तुलना तभी संभव है जब दो या दो से अधिक वर्षों का विवरण उपलब्ध हो। बैलेंस शीट के कुल को आधार माना जाता है, और संबंधित वर्ष की देनदारियों और संपत्तियों को बैलेंस शीट के कुल के अनुपात में प्रकट किया जाता है। यहाँ, अनुपात लंबवत रूप में निर्धारित किए जाते हैं।
body_gu: સમાન માપનું પાકું સરવૈયું (બેલેન્સ શીટ): તેનું માળખું નીચે મુજબ છે. પાકા સરવૈયાની તમામ વિગતો જેવી છે તેવી જ દર્શાવવામાં આવે છે. બે વર્ષની રકમ દર્શાવવામાં આવે છે. સરખામણી ત્યારે જ શક્ય છે જ્યારે બે કે તેથી વધુ વર્ષોની વિગતો ઉપલબ્ધ હોય. પાકા સરવૈયાના કુલ સરવાળાને આધાર તરીકે ગણવામાં આવે છે, અને સંબંધિત વર્ષની જવાબદારીઓ અને સંપત્તિઓને પાકા સરવૈયાના કુલ સરવાળાના પ્રમાણમાં દર્શાવવામાં આવે છે. અહીં, પ્રમાણ ઊભી રીતે નક્કી કરવામાં આવે છે.

question:
Complete the following common size profit and loss statement of Shri Ram Limited by ascertaining balancing figures.

**Common Size Profit and Loss Statement of Shri Ram Limited
Year Ending on 31-3-2016 and 31-3-2017**

| Particulars | Note No. | Amount (₹) 31-3-2016 | Amount (₹) 31-3-2017 | Percentage to sales (%) 31-3-2016 | Percentage to sales (%) 31-3-2017 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| (I) Sales revenue | | 25,00,000 | 30,00,000 | 100 | 100 |
| (II) Expenses: | | | | | |
| (i) Cost of goods consumed | | ? | ? | 75 | 78 |
| (ii) Financial expenses | | ? | ? | 9.6 | 8 |
| (iii) Depreciation | | ? | ? | 3 | 4 |
| **Total expenses** | | **21,90,000** | **27,00,000** | **87.6** | **90** |
| (III) Profit before tax | | 3,10,000 | 3,00,000 | 12.4 | 10 |
| (IV) Less: Income tax 30 % | | ? | 90,000 | 3.72 | 3 |
| (V) Profit after tax | | ? | 2,10,000 | 8.68 | 7 |
solution:
**Explanation :** The sales is the base of all the revenues and expenses for the common size profit and loss statement. The proportion of the other income and expenses to sales is ascertained. 
Amount of revenue/expense = (Net sales × Percentage of revenue/expense/tax) / 100

**Necessary calculation:**
* **Cost of goods consumed:** 2016 = 25,00,000 × 75/100 = 18,75,000; 2017 = 30,00,000 × 78/100 = 23,40,000
* **Financial cost:** 2016 = 25,00,000 × 9.6/100 = 2,40,000; 2017 = 30,00,000 × 8/100 = 2,40,000
* **Depreciation:** 2016 = 25,00,000 × 3/100 = 75,000; 2017 = 30,00,000 × 4/100 = 1,20,000
* **Income tax:** 2016 = 25,00,000 × 3.72/100 = 93,000
* **Profit after tax:** 2016 = 25,00,000 × 8.68/100 = 2,17,000

| (II) Expenses: | | | | | |
| (i) Cost of goods consumed | | **18,75,000** | **23,40,000** | 75 | 78 |
| (ii) Financial cost | | **2,40,000** | **2,40,000** | 9.6 | 8 |
| (iii) Depreciation | | **75,000** | **1,20,000** | 3 | 4 |
| **Total expenses** | | 21,90,000 | 27,00,000 | 87.6 | 90 |
| (III) Profit before tax | | 3,10,000 | 3,00,000 | 12.4 | 10 |
